scripts.build: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/css dist/public/images && npm run build:css && npm run build:html && npm run copy:assets
scripts.build:css: timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d) && cleancss -o dist/css/styles.min.$timestamp.css css/styles.css && cleancss -o dist/css/reset.min.$timestamp.css css/reset.css
scripts.copy:assets: cp favicon.ico dist/ && cp -r public/images/* dist/public/images/ && npm run update:html
